context: ProofWiki abstract ring convention: associative multiplication, no required multiplicative identity

formulations.context_scope: This includes associative non-unital rings; standard commutative algebra sources commonly impose unity separately.
formulations.text: An associative ring R is a set with operations + and · for which (R,+) is an abelian group, (R,·) is associative, and multiplication distributes over addition on both sides. A multiplicative identity is not part of this particular source's general ring axioms.

context: Stacks Project Definition 4.2.1: categories with a set of objects and a set of morphisms for each ordered pair

formulations.context_scope: Stacks 4.2.1: 'small' means object collection is a set, not merely a proper class; avoid automatically generalizing to big categories.
formulations.text: A small category C has a set Ob(C) of objects, sets Hom_C(x,y) for every ordered pair of objects, composition maps Hom_C(y,z)×Hom_C(x,y)→Hom_C(x,z), and arrows id_x∈Hom_C(x,x); compositions are associative and identities act as left and right units.
